name: accounts-settings
description: Read or write Accounts's settings (namespace accounts-settings).

action.description: read every row, or write one.

key.description: messagePollSeconds — Message poll interval (number); showOfflineMembers — Show offline members (switch); denseTables — Dense tables (switch); floatablePanes — Floatable panes & toolbars (IDE style) (switch); editUi — Edit UI (switch)

value.description: The new value when writing; matches the row's declared kind.
